method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: May 15 wording retained; note distinguishes declaration, mandate expiry and US recognition with time zones.
Original East Germany retained; note explains occupation-zone context before 1949 state formation.
Original past 12 months includes Taft-Hartley, enacted June 1947 before the 1948 convention by more than 12 months. Preserve and disclose broad timing.

revisions.source: The idea is definitely getting around that you are soft on Communism. Party operatives are scratching their heads right now.
revisions.zh: 你对共产主义过于软弱的说法，确实正在流传。党内操盘手眼下都感到摸不着头脑。

revisions.source: This sounds a little too liberal for the direction of your party and supporters.
revisions.zh: 相对于本党及支持者的倾向，这听起来有点过于自由派了。

revisions.source: This is a good way to point to the positive accomplishments of your party.
revisions.zh: 这是强调本党积极政绩的好办法。

revisions.source: You're repeating a Harry Truman line with this statement.
revisions.zh: 这番话是在重复哈里·杜鲁门的说法。

revisions.source: Your experience in New York shows that expansive programs and a balanced budget are not mutually exclusive.
revisions.zh: 你在纽约州的经历表明，扩大政府计划与实现预算平衡，并不互相排斥。

revisions.source: Supporters are energized by your aggressive campaign. And inflation is an issue that worries everyone right now.
revisions.zh: 你积极进攻的竞选让支持者振奋。通货膨胀眼下也是所有人都担忧的问题。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about your announced running mate, Earl Warren?
revisions.zh: 对于已经宣布的竞选搭档厄尔·沃伦，你有什么话要说？

revisions.source: A wave of strikes and economic turmoil has led to bipartisan support for a new labor law. Do you support Truman's decision to veto the Taft-Hartley Act?
revisions.zh: 一波罢工潮和经济动荡，使两党都开始支持一项新的劳工法。你支持杜鲁门否决《塔夫脱—哈特利法》的决定吗？

revisions.source: The Jewish state of Israel is set to declare its independence on May 15, 1948. Do you support Truman's decision to recognize this new nation?
revisions.zh: 犹太国家以色列准备在1948年5月15日宣布独立。你支持杜鲁门承认这个新国家的决定吗？

revisions.source: To what extent will you emphasize your support for civil rights legislation in New York as you hit the campaign trail?
revisions.zh: 展开竞选时，你会在多大程度上强调自己在纽约州支持民权立法的政绩？

revisions.source: To what extent are you prepared to make anti-Communism an issue in this campaign, or to attack Harry Truman on the issue?
revisions.zh: 你准备在多大程度上把反共作为竞选议题，或就此抨击哈里·杜鲁门？

revisions.source: Do you have any comments to make on the Soviet blockade of Berlin, and the airlift in progress to resupply that city?
revisions.zh: 对于苏联封锁柏林，以及正在进行、为该城补充物资的空运，你有什么意见？

revisions.source: What will be the main focus of your acceptance speech at the Republican Convention?
revisions.zh: 你在共和党全国代表大会的接受提名演说，会以什么为重点？

revisions.source: Your party has passed a fairly ambitious and liberal platform which you have supported. However, if the Republican Congress won't pass these laws now, how do you expect to push them forward as President?
revisions.zh: 本党通过了一份相当雄心勃勃、带有自由派色彩的党纲，你也表示支持。但如果共和党控制的国会现在不肯通过这些法律，你又如何期待自己当上总统之后能推动它们？

revisions.source: Do you advocate the international control of nuclear weapons under the United Nations?
revisions.zh: 你主张在联合国框架下，对核武器实行国际管制吗？

revisions.source: What do you think about proposals for the federal government to build an expansive interstate highway system?
revisions.zh: 对于由联邦政府建设大规模州际公路系统的提议，你怎么看？

revisions.source: Before you head to New York to spend the election day, is there one last place you want to hit on the campaign trail?
revisions.zh: 在前往纽约州度过选举日之前，你还想最后去哪个地方拉票？

revisions.source: Absolutely not. This is a perfectly reasonable measure, designed to prevent a strike in one industry from crippling the American economy.
revisions.zh: 绝不支持。这是一项完全合理的措施，旨在避免某个行业的罢工使美国经济陷入瘫痪。

revisions.source: I support Truman's veto. The National Labor Relations Act was put in place to protect the rights of labor, and it should be respected.
revisions.zh: 我支持杜鲁门的否决。《全国劳工关系法》是为保护劳工权利而制定的，理应得到尊重。

revisions.source: I've supported the Israeli state from the beginning. I'm glad that Truman came around, but he absolutely sent the wrong message by vacillating on this issue until the very last moment.
revisions.zh: 我从一开始就支持以色列建国。很高兴杜鲁门终于改变态度，但他一直摇摆到最后一刻，显然传递了错误的信号。

revisions.source: I support the Israeli state, and I'm pleased that Truman and I are in agreement on this issue.
revisions.zh: 我支持以色列，也很高兴杜鲁门和我在这个问题上意见一致。

revisions.source: I believe it was a hasty and impetuous move by the Truman Administration to support the creation of Israel. I have to come out against this measure.
revisions.zh: 我认为，杜鲁门政府支持建立以色列，是仓促、冲动之举。我必须公开反对这项措施。

revisions.source: Not only will I speak about this issue, but I will use it to attack Truman. I've supported civil rights all along, while Truman seems to have come around at the 11th hour, and for transparent political gain.
revisions.zh: 我不仅会谈这个问题，还会用它来抨击杜鲁门。我一直支持民权，而杜鲁门似乎到最后关头才改变态度，目的显然是捞取政治利益。

revisions.source: I think part of any good campaign involves speaking about my past, and as Governor of New York I successfully pushed for some of the first anti-discrimination laws in the country.
revisions.zh: 我认为，任何出色的竞选都应当谈谈自己的经历。担任纽约州州长时，我成功推动了全国最早的一批反歧视法律。

revisions.source: My record speaks for itself. For the time being, we just need to keep the party energized and avoid any statements which might be deemed as controversial.
revisions.zh: 我的政绩已经说明了一切。眼下，我们只需要保持党内热情，避免任何可能被认为有争议的言论。

revisions.source: Not only is this a serious issue, but Harry Truman is complicit in it. It is no secret that he is, along with most Democrats, complacent on the issue of Communist infiltration.
revisions.zh: 这不仅是个严重问题，哈里·杜鲁门也负有责任。他和大多数民主党人一样，在共产党渗透问题上掉以轻心，这并不是什么秘密。

revisions.source: I think there are legitimate questions to be asked about how much the Communists have embedded themselves into departments of the government. I support the measures we have in place to combat this.
revisions.zh: 共产党人在政府部门中究竟扎根多深，确实值得追问。我支持现有的应对措施。

revisions.source: If you'll remember my debate with Harold Stassen, I got this nomination in the first place by remaining above such type of politics.
revisions.zh: 如果你还记得我与哈罗德·史塔森的辩论，就会知道，我之所以获得提名，正是因为没有陷入这种政治手段。

revisions.source: I would have us move into East Germany if this blockade continues. We're the ones with a nuclear bomb. Why should we be afraid of the Soviets?
revisions.zh: 如果封锁继续，我会让我们进入东德。拥有核弹的是我们，为什么要怕苏联？

revisions.source: I support our current airlift and hope that it leads to an agreeable conclusion.
revisions.zh: 我支持当前的空运，希望它能促成各方可以接受的结局。

revisions.source: We need to pull back from West Berlin and maintain a more realistic defense perimeter. We're more likely to be drawn into World War III than to gain anything useful from the defense of that exclave.
revisions.zh: 我们需要撤出西柏林，维持一条更现实的防线。保卫这块飞地，更可能让我们卷入第三次世界大战，而不是带来什么实际好处。

revisions.source: Harry Truman is an ineffectual, vacillating, highly unpopular President. We need to hammer on this theme and remind the American people why they need a new leader in the White House.
revisions.zh: 哈里·杜鲁门是一位无能、摇摆不定、极不受欢迎的总统。我们需要反复强调这个主题，提醒美国人民为什么白宫需要一位新的领袖。

revisions.source: I will talk about what I have accomplished in New York -- public works, a balanced budget, anti-discrimination laws, business creation, and funding for teachers and universities. This is the future of our party.
revisions.zh: 我会谈自己在纽约州取得的成就：公共工程、预算平衡、反歧视法律、促进企业发展，以及为教师和大学提供资金。这就是本党的未来。

revisions.source: I will put out the olive branch to our conservative friends and talk about the need for less spending, a limited foreign policy, and Communist influence in the government.
revisions.zh: 我会向保守派朋友伸出橄榄枝，谈谈削减开支、有限度的外交政策，以及政府中的共产党影响。

revisions.source: We're way ahead, so why screw up a good thing? I will talk in general about the future greatness of this country once I'm President, and avoid alienating any potential allies or partners in government.
revisions.zh: 我们遥遥领先，何必搞砸大好局面？我会泛泛谈论自己当上总统之后，这个国家将有多么伟大的未来，避免疏远任何潜在盟友或执政伙伴。

revisions.source: Just in the past 12 months, Congress has passed the Marshall Plan and Taft-Hartley with bipartisan support. They have passed an expansive farm bill, and will be considering housing legislation soon. I don't see why I couldn't work with this Congress.
revisions.zh: 仅仅过去十二个月，国会就以两党支持通过了马歇尔计划和《塔夫脱—哈特利法》。他们通过了一项内容广泛的农业法案，而且即将审议住房立法。我看不出自己有什么理由不能与这个国会合作。

revisions.source: I believe that a Republican Congress, working with a Republican President, will be able to come to accord on the key issues of our time.
revisions.zh: 我相信，共和党控制的国会与共和党总统合作，能够在当今重大议题上达成一致。

revisions.source: Why not campaign in New York itself?
revisions.zh: 为什么不就在纽约州竞选呢？

revisions.source: We'll arrive in New York via Ohio and Pennsylvania.
revisions.zh: 我们途经俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州，最后抵达纽约州。

revisions.source: I'll spend the last day in California with my running mate, and then fly back to New York.
revisions.zh: 我会在加利福尼亚州与竞选搭档一起度过最后一天，然后飞回纽约州。

revisions.source: We'll barnstorm as much of the Midwest as we can, going from state to state.
revisions.zh: 我们会尽可能在中西部巡回拉票，一个州接着一个州。

revisions.source: Anyone can see that I've supported road development throughout my career, and I think this would be a positive step for the country.
revisions.zh: 谁都看得出，我在整个政治生涯中一直支持道路建设。我认为，这对本国是积极的一步。

revisions.source: It would depend on the scope of the program. We could certainly use a limited number of modern, well-constructed federal roads to connect our different regions.
revisions.zh: 这取决于计划的规模。建设少量现代化、质量良好的联邦道路，连接不同地区，确实会有用。

revisions.source: I'm not so sure about this. Such a system will surely displace many existing towns and neighborhoods, and provide an entirely new area for federal interference in local matters.
revisions.zh: 我对此并不十分赞同。这样的系统必定会迫使许多现有城镇和社区迁移，也会为联邦干预地方事务开辟一个全新领域。

revisions.source: I think this is a necessary expedient which we should implement immediately. It is important to set a precedent now, before other countries develop the bomb, that nuclear war will never again become state policy.
revisions.zh: 我认为，这是必要的应对办法，应该立即实施。在其他国家研制出核弹之前，我们必须确立先例：核战争绝不能再成为国家政策。

revisions.source: Only if we had clear assurances that other nations would not develop a nuclear bomb, and a means of enforcing those assurances.
revisions.zh: 只有在明确保证其他国家不会研制核弹，并有办法确保这些保证兑现的情况下，我才支持。

revisions.source: We need to be realistic. Would the Soviet Union do such a thing if they developed a nuclear bomb? I would never support this action.
revisions.zh: 我们需要现实一点。如果苏联研制出了核弹，它会这么做吗？我绝不会支持这项行动。

revisions.source: Earl Warren is a great man who represents my views for the future of this country. Now let's get going with this campaign.
revisions.zh: 厄尔·沃伦是位出色的人物，代表了我对本国未来的看法。现在，让我们开始竞选吧。

revisions.source: The Berlin Airlift is dominating the headlines and building positive sentiment for Truman. But that's the way things go...
revisions.zh: 柏林空运占据新闻头条，给杜鲁门带来了良好的舆论。不过，事情就是这样……

revisions.source: This idea does not appeal to most Americans, though you might get a few Henry Wallace supporters.
revisions.zh: 这个主张不受大多数美国人欢迎，不过你也许能争取到少数亨利·华莱士的支持者。

revisions.source: Nearly every Republican in Congress voted in support of Taft-Hartley, and Robert Taft is a key member of the party. There is definitely consternation at your stance.
revisions.zh: 国会中几乎所有共和党人都投票支持《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，罗伯特·塔夫脱也是本党的重要人物。你的立场确实让党内感到不安。

revisions.source: Your attacks on Truman are making headlines. Pundits speculate that you will repeat your aggressive tactics of 1944.
revisions.zh: 你对杜鲁门的抨击登上了头条。评论人士猜测，你会再次采用1944年的进攻策略。

revisions.source: It's good to support Israel, especially if you expect to win your home state this fall.
revisions.zh: 支持以色列是好事，尤其如果你希望今年秋季赢下自己的家乡州。

revisions.source: This seems to be a change of heart from your earlier position.
revisions.zh: 这似乎表明，你改变了此前的立场。

revisions.source: “Dewey hits back on civil rights” say the headlines. People are noticing.
revisions.zh: “杜威在民权问题上反击”，新闻头条这样写道。人们正在注意此事。

revisions.source: There's nothing wrong with pointing to a positive record of accomplishment.
revisions.zh: 强调自己的积极政绩，没有什么不妥。

revisions.source: People had their doubts about whether you were prepared to energize your base with the communism issue, but you have proven them wrong.
revisions.zh: 人们原本怀疑，你是否准备借共产主义议题激发基本盘，但你证明他们想错了。

revisions.source: This is a decent talking point for 1948.
revisions.zh: 在1948年，这是一个不错的竞选论点。

revisions.source: This is somewhat true, but it seems like you are leaving a potential line of attack on the table.
revisions.zh: 这话有几分道理，但你似乎放弃了一条潜在的进攻路线。

revisions.source: Not only is Truman enjoying a wave of positive publicity for the Berlin Airlift, but your own ideas seem extreme to the public.
revisions.zh: 杜鲁门正享受柏林空运带来的正面宣传，而你的主张在公众看来又过于极端。

revisions.source: This stance has appeal to what remains of the isolationists, but to most it seems like a dangerous retreat in the face of Communist aggression.
revisions.zh: 这个立场对剩下的孤立主义者有吸引力，但对大多数人来说，这是面对共产主义侵略时的危险退却。

revisions.source: You've certainly made headlines with your attacks, but with Truman so unpopular, it might be for the best.
revisions.zh: 你的抨击确实登上了头条，不过杜鲁门如此不受欢迎，这样做也许才是上策。

revisions.source: This is a positive campaign message, and it should especially reinforce your lead in your home state.
revisions.zh: 这是一个积极的竞选主题，尤其应该能巩固你在家乡州的领先优势。

revisions.source: Republican delegates are happy, but is staunch conservatism the best route to electoral success in this era?
revisions.zh: 共和党代表很高兴，但在这个时代，坚定的保守主义真是赢得选举的最佳路线吗？

revisions.source: You're certainly drawing good crowds, but word has it that Truman is doing even better on that front. Fortunately you should win where it matters -- in the ballot box.
revisions.zh: 你的活动确实吸引了很多人，但据说杜鲁门在这方面表现更好。幸好，你应该能在真正重要的地方——票箱里——获胜。

revisions.source: Another attack on Truman. Political junkies are delighted by the back-and-forth in this campaign between the two of you.
revisions.zh: 又一次抨击杜鲁门。你们俩在竞选中你来我往，让政治迷们十分过瘾。

revisions.source: Advisers like the bland, non-committal nature of this answer. The important thing is to play it safe and preserve your lead in the polls.
revisions.zh: 顾问们喜欢这个回答平淡、不作承诺的特点。重要的是稳扎稳打，保住民调领先。

revisions.source: What an exciting last day of the campaign! Let's see how the voting goes tomorrow.
revisions.zh: 竞选的最后一天真热闹！看看明天的投票结果吧。

revisions.source: This idea does not appeal to most Americans, especially in your party.
revisions.zh: 这个主张不受大多数美国人欢迎，在你党内尤其如此。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about your announced running mate, Harold Stassen?
revisions.zh: 对于已经宣布的竞选搭档哈罗德·史塔森，你有什么话要说？

revisions.source: How concerned are you about events in China? What would you do as President to support Chiang Kai-Shek?
revisions.zh: 你对中国的事态有多担忧？作为总统，你会采取什么措施支持蒋介石？

revisions.source: A number of Congressional candidates have made anti-Communism and accusations of Communist sympathies a centerpiece of their political campaigns. Do you support this trend?
revisions.zh: 一些国会议员候选人把反共及指控对手同情共产党，作为竞选的核心。你支持这个趋势吗？

revisions.source: We need to be doing more to defend our ally in China. I believe that country is in very real danger of falling to the Communists if we don't step in somehow.
revisions.zh: 我们应该做更多事情，保卫我们在中国的盟友。我认为，如果我们不以某种方式介入，中国确实有落入共产党之手的危险。

revisions.source: China is a crucial ally, under duress, and I support Chiang Kai-Shek and the Nationalists in their struggle.
revisions.zh: 中国是一个处境危急的重要盟友。我支持蒋介石和国民党进行的斗争。

revisions.source: Publicly, of course, I support any ally of the United States. But Kai-Shek has proven himself to be a disappointment, if you really want to know the truth. I will be careful about making any statement or policy which would commit the U.S. to his further defense.
revisions.zh: 在公开场合，我当然支持美国的任何盟友。不过，真要说实话，蒋介石的表现令人失望。我会谨慎作出任何表态或政策，以免使美国承诺进一步保卫他。
